entries.title: Sports process lessons filed from shadow settle (SP-L01–L05)
entries.summary: Five dated process/falsifier lessons from the 2026-09-13 shadow settle: thin SP sample kill (2026-09-12), ace≠full-game proxy (2026-09-12), bullpen leverage gate (2026-09-09), key-3 half-point fragile (2026-09-09), lagged dog number capture (2026-09-11). Behavior changes noted in lessons.csv.
entries.deskChanges: Appended SP-L01–SP-L05 to lessons.csv; Session Log entries for each; Sports desk lessons feed on next publish.

entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L05 (origination 2026-09-11)
entries.summary: Experience: MICH +5.5 entered after dog number restored; covered; close ~+4.5. Evidence: Lagged dog number captured +1pt vs close; positive process CLV. Learning: Lagged dog-number capture works when gate is explicit and number restores. Change: Keep conditional reopen gates on dog numbers; track number CLV separately from juice CLV.
entries.deskChanges: Lesson SP-L05 filed to journal/lessons.csv with originationDate 2026-09-11.

entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L04 (origination 2026-09-09)
entries.summary: Experience: SEA −3.5 lost on exact-3 margin (13-10). Evidence: Key number 3 is fragile for −3.5 chalk; dog +3.5 covered. Learning: Key-3 half-point favorite (−3.5) is fragile — prefer +3.5 dog side or require stronger MoS. Change: NFL key-number screen: −3.5 chalk needs extra MoS; default prefer buying +3.5 when near fair.
entries.deskChanges: Lesson SP-L04 filed to journal/lessons.csv with originationDate 2026-09-09.

entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L03 (origination 2026-09-09)
entries.summary: Experience: STL ML led late; Giants 6-run 8th; SF 7-6. Evidence: Early edge erased by bullpen collapse; no leverage gate. Learning: Bullpen leverage gate was missing on MLB ML shadows. Change: Same as SP-L02 — ML keepers need bullpen/leverage check or move to runline/abstain.
entries.deskChanges: Lesson SP-L03 filed to journal/lessons.csv with originationDate 2026-09-09.

entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L02 (origination 2026-09-12)
entries.summary: Experience: PIT ML with Skenes: ace left ahead; Soto blew 8th; CHC 4-3. Evidence: SP thesis held early; bullpen/leverage decided ML. Learning: Ace start is not a full-game ML proxy — need bullpen/leverage gate for ML tickets. Change: ML shadows require explicit late-inning/bullpen note; else prefer RL/+1.5 or abstain.
entries.deskChanges: Lesson SP-L02 filed to journal/lessons.csv with originationDate 2026-09-12.

entries.title: Sports lesson SP-L01 (origination 2026-09-12)
entries.summary: Experience: CLE ML shadowed despite Espino thin-sample flag; MIN won 4-3. Evidence: Thin SP n was already a named kill/concern and still logged as keeper; loss followed. Learning: Thin SP sample kill rule must fire — flag → abstain/shadow-only-kill, not keeper. Change: Pre-shadow checklist: if SP sample thin, default abstain unless independent build clears MoS without SP weight.
entries.deskChanges: Lesson SP-L01 filed to journal/lessons.csv with originationDate 2026-09-12.
